cards.explanation: The answer is Josiah son of Zephaniah. Zechariah is told to take the offering from the exiles and go to that house that same day. The text gives us the name and that instruction, and that's all it gives. I'll leave it right there, friends.

The answer is Joshua son of Jehozadak. The crown goes on the head of the high priest, and God names the head, the metal and the man all in one verse. That's clear directions, friends, and I wish my oven manual was half as clear.

The answer is temple. The man called the Branch will branch out from His place and build the temple of the LORD. God says it in verse 12 and then says it again in verse 13. When God repeats Himself, friends, you write it down.

The answer is a priest. Verse 13 says, "And He will be a priest on His throne…" So He sits on a throne and rules, and He's a priest right there on it. Two jobs, one throne, friends, and I can barely keep one cookie tray straight.
The answer is False. The text says, "…there will be peaceful counsel between the two." He rules and He's a priest on His throne, and the word is peaceful. Friends, no rivalry anywhere in that verse.
The answer is True. Verse 15 says, "Even those far away will come and build the temple of the LORD…" So the building reaches the ones who are far away. That's a big circle, friends.

The answer is obey. The last line says, "This will happen if you diligently obey the voice of the LORD your God." Notice the word diligently, friends. It means this obeying is no half-hearted nod, and I've nodded along at my oven timer plenty of times.
